resources.string: Write-only spatial touchpad gesture dispatcher for USB-C AR glasses (XREAL Air 2 Pro, VITURE Pro XR, Rokid Max, RayNeo Air 2s) in Google Pixel Desktop Mode. Does not read screen content or collect data.
Tuned for 240Hz batch sampling on optical see-through AR displays
Content tracks finger motion during 2-finger drag across the touchpad
1-finger tap for Left Click, 2-finger tap for Right Click
Service Inactive • Tap to Review & Enable
Pixel AR Touchpad uses the Android AccessibilityService API to operate as an eyes-free touchpad when USB-C AR glasses are connected.

Used exclusively to dispatch 1-finger Left Clicks, 2-finger Right Clicks, and 2-finger Scroll gestures onto external USB-C DisplayPort Alt-Mode AR displays and auto-launch the touchpad when glasses connect.
Configured with canRetrieveWindowContent=\"false\" and empty accessibilityEventTypes. The app cannot read screen text, UI hierarchies, passwords, or keystrokes.
This app declares zero manifest permissions (no Internet access) and never collects, stores, or transmits any personal or sensitive user data.
